token.title: Lumin Account Authentication
token.description:
Enter your tokens from the Lumin portal.

1. Go to {portal_url}
2. Log in with your Lumin account
3. Open browser DevTools (F12)
4. Go to Application → Local Storage
5. Copy `access_token` and `refresh_token`

The refresh token keeps the integration authenticated indefinitely.
